title: Can you still buy an Austin today?
author: Les Caramagnols
excerpt: Buying an Austin is still possible, but the right choice depends on model, corrosion, parts and intended use.
content:
Buying an Austin today is still possible, but the market is not uniform. A Seven, Cambridge, A40 Farina, Austin-badged Mini and Austin-Healey are not found with the same ease, cost or maintenance needs.

The starting point is not the Austin name alone. It is the exact model, condition, paperwork, parts availability and planned use after purchase.

Value is a whole picture

The Austin page helps place the model families. For a small Austin kept for leisure driving, our Mini Mayfair gives a practical example.
